purpose: Trigger evaluation corpus for ci-cd-optimize. Labels are frozen before description tuning. Categories: direct-positive, indirect-positive, uncommon-positive, near-miss-negative, simple-negative, competing-negative.

cases.query: Our GitHub Actions CI takes 35 minutes on every PR. Can you figure out why and speed it up without breaking required checks?
optimize our ci pipeline, it's way too slow and expensive lately
The e2e workflow in .github/workflows/e2e.yml keeps queueing for 10+ minutes before it even starts. Diagnose the queue time.
Our GitLab CI cache never seems to hit — every job reinstalls node_modules from scratch. Fix the caching.
CI bill doubled this month. Find what's burning runner minutes in our monorepo pipelines and cut it safely.
pls audit why buildkite builds got slower after we added the new integration test step
Tests are flaky in CI only — retries mask it and the suite takes forever. Investigate and make the pipeline reliable and faster.
We migrated to avrea runners for GitHub Actions. Measure whether they're actually faster than the old hosted runners for our ci.yml.
Every push I wait like 20 min for the checks before I can merge, it used to be 8. Something changed, can you look?
Devs are complaining that draft PRs run the full expensive test matrix. Feels wasteful.
After adding the docker build step the feedback loop on PRs got painful. The image rebuilds everything each time.
I pushed a fix 5 minutes ago — set something up so you know the moment CI finishes on that exact commit and react if it goes red, without just sleeping.
circleci says our workflow ran 40 jobs but wall time barely improved when we added more parallelism. why
Xcode builds on our macOS CI runners take 50 minutes; simulators, DerivedData, the works. Where do we even start measuring?
Our self-hosted runner pool saturates every day around 3pm and jobs pile up. Do we resize, add runners, or merge jobs?
Bazel remote cache is configured but CI is not faster. Verify it's actually being used and whether it's worth keeping.
Write a short glossary entry explaining what a CI/CD pipeline is for our onboarding docs.
Our production API endpoint /search is slow, p95 is 2 seconds. Profile the Node service and optimize the query path.
Compare CircleCI vs GitHub Actions pricing tiers for a 10-person startup and recommend one.
The nightly cron job that syncs our CRM data to the warehouse is timing out. Debug the sync script.
There's a typo in .github/workflows/ci.yml — the job name says 'biuld'. Fix it.
Bump actions/setup-node from v4 to v5 in our workflow file.
Deploy the latest main of our compose app to Coolify and verify the health endpoint comes up.
Review this PR diff for security issues in the new auth middleware before we merge.
